items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: "Hi, Tom, how's the wife and kids?"

ctx.x: the fact of "Hi, Tom, how's the wife and kids?" "Oh, fine." And they'd have a conversation. "What have you been doing?" "Oh, I was up and some creek or something the other day. They were really biting up there." And I'm sitting there. "Oh, by the way, this is John Malachi. John, this is Judge So-and-So." And I would meet him... I had never known just what happened in the judge's chambers. After a while, another guy would come in, and I would be introduced to him, and they would have the same kind of conversation,…

Anyway, I got this letter from the Navy that these two girls were asking me if I would write to them and state to them what had happened in this case, and these two little girls, it seemed as if their backs had been broken or something. Of course, their parents were dead, and the third party in the car happened to be an uncle who was German, and they had been to New York to pick him up and bring him... This was his first time in the United States.
